01 About us

二十多年，
專注把設計做成實體Two decades of turning designs into reality

原鯨企業有限公司成立於 2004 年 12 月，廠房佔地 350 坪，擁有優秀的設計團隊為客戶服務。我們以品質、納期為第一優先，深獲業界肯定與好評。

Founded in December 2004, 原鯨企業 operates a 350-ping (≈1,157 m²) facility and serves its customers through a strong in-house design team. Quality and on-time delivery come first — a commitment that has earned the trust of the industry.

從設計、加工、焊接到精密量測都在廠內完成，讓每一套設備與治具都能精準掌握品質與交期。

Design, machining, welding and precision measurement all happen under one roof, so every system and fixture we deliver is controlled end to end.

  • 2004公司成立，投入自動化與夾治具設計製造Company founded; automation and jig & fixture design-build
  • 2008與先構技研合作，推動數位工場自動化Partnership with 先構技研 to advance digital factory automation
  • 今日Today服務國內主要車廠、零組件大廠與海外 OEMServing major Taiwanese automakers, Tier 1 suppliers and overseas OEMs
